newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico first-half CPI rose 2.34 percent - Banco.
newsitem.headline: Mexico first-half CPI rose 2.34 percent - Banco.

text.p: Mexico's consumer price index rose 2.34 percent in the first half of December from the last two weeks of November, Banco de Mexico said.
It said that the basic basket of consumer goods rose 4.03 percent in the first two weeks of December compared with the last two weeks of the previous month.

The Banco said that the higher than expected price index increase was influenced especially by nationwide hikes in gasoline prices, and by higher public transport costs in the Mexico City metropolitan area.
Excluding those increases the consumer price index would have risen 1.30 percent in the first two weeks of December.
